description.narrative: New approaches for combatting corruption and other undue influences on political decision-makingTI participation in this 15-member consortium contributes specifically to WP5 mostly (IW data updates, most case studies & book, and T-Index), and to some extent to both WP2 (contributing to 1 or 2 of case studies), and WP10 (policy options, outreach and dissemination). Our BridgeGap /Horizon deliverables will support updates and case studies with IW Europe platforms and data during 2024 and 2025, respectively, after the current project (IW 3.0) ends.Research consortium: TI is leading on elements falling under work package 5: Qualitative report on the impact of transparency on government favoritism (public contracts and legislation) in 15 EU MS and EU institutions with supporting data. The different elements under this package are not produced and delivered only by TI but in close coordination and partnership with different consortium members. TI will also contribute to work packages 2 and 10. Our contributions consist of supporting with thought leadership to the expansion of the Transparency Index in Europe, leveraging IW 3.0 data to develop case studies on the impact of transparency on undue influencing and political corruption (WP2 and WP 5), support database updates as deemed necessary for the research (WP5), and support policy engagement by chapters in their own countries (WP 10). For that, we envision proposing up to 15 subgrants to interested Chapters. While WP10 is still in development, TI will be coming in only on a very specific task focused on Engaging policy and decision-makers on national levels (an element included within the chapters budget allocation) . In addition to contributing to SO3 Secure integrity in politics, this project also demonstrates our commitment to evidence-based practices. As a result of the project, TI-S will be able to revise its assumptions about transparency and update the tech tools used for IW (automation of some platforms that will make them self-sustaining).Value of contract: EUR 600,000

recipient-region.narrative: The following are recipient countries:Belgium, Bulgaria, France, Germany, Israel, Italy, The Netherlands, Romania, Scotland, Spain, Sweden, Ukraine, and the United States of America.
